passages.text:
Re: Connecting the dots between FB US policy team and USAID
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Ajit Mohan Tuesday, April 27, 2021 at 12:17:11 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Anjali Kaur, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Brian Rice
Fantastic to hear both of you are connected. Anjali, we will lean in wherever we can if there are real
opportunities to make an impact on the ground immediately.
Ajit
From: Anjali Kaur <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Tuesday, April 27, 2021 9:02 AM
To: Brian Rice - [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Ajit Mohan < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Connecting the dots between FB US policy team and USAID
This is fantastic news! Really great to see such a sizable amount being announced! And you are working with my former
employer - UNICEF who I love.
We are sorting out next steps from our end on collaboration and should have updates by tomorrow.
More soon!
Änjali
On Mon, Apr 26, 2021 at 6:35 PM Brian Rice - [opaque block]
Thanks again for your time today Anjali. Making sure you have Mark's announcement from this afternoon—look
forward to following up with you on next steps for how best to work with USAID.
[access or personal detail omitted]
Get Outlook for iOS
From: Anjali Kaur <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, April 26, 2021 9:30:03 AM
To: Brian Rice < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Ajit Mohan < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Connecting the dots between FB US policy team and USAID
Thank you, Ajit and great to meet you as well, Brian! I would love to connect the dots on your conversations across the
USG so we can get on the same page and also give you a sense of what we are doing here at USAID. Have copied in
my colleague Megan to help us find a time today or tomorrow based on your schedule.
Many thanks everyone!
Anjali
Änjali Kaur
Deputy Assistant Administrator
USAID | Bureau for Asia
[opaque block]
[contact omitted]
On Mon, Apr 26, 2021 at 6:50 AM Brian Rice < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>wrote:
Thank you Ajit, and hello Anjali—glad to be connected. We have been working through Andy Slavitt at the White
House on a number of Covid related issues and plan to reach out this morning to offer support. Please let us know if
there are any details that would help guide our efforts or if it makes sense to connect by phone this morning—this is a
very high priority for us.

Thanks,
Brian
Get Outlook for iOS
From: Ajit Mohan < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, April 26, 2021 7:27:55 AM
To: Brian Rice < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; [contact omitted] <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Connecting the dots between FB US policy team and USAID
Brian, Anjali, a quick note to introduce the two of you.
Brian, Anjali is the Deputy Assistant Administrator for USAID-Asia and the Asia POC for COVID. She
had reached out to me yesterday about efforts that she is involved in where USG is putting together
a program to get medical grade tankers, oxygen plants and genome testing kits into India. She
mentioned that they are looking for private sector support.
Anjali,Brian is Public Policy Director in the US team and in touch with the WH on the same efforts.
Maybe the dots are all getting connected but wanted to make sure both of you are in touch.
Anjali, as I mentioned, FB as a company is very open to making a contribution.
Hope this helps.
Ajit
Änjali Kaur
Deputy Assistant Administrator
USAID | Bureau for Asia
[opaque block]
[contact omitted]
